program.name: Athlete Volume
program.subject: Athlete
program.blurb: Three athletic days: jumps and legs, explosive push-ups and upper strength, side jumps and single-leg work.
program.about: An athlete's week in three days. Vertical jumps lead into squats and hinges, explosive push-ups into presses and rows, and lateral bounds into single-leg strength. Balance work closes every session. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Vertical jump & lower / upper power & upper / lateral jump & single leg
